mapper.insert: insert into toy_community_like (post_id, user_id, create_time) values (#{postId}, #{userId}, sysdate())
mapper.delete: delete from toy_community_like where post_id = #{postId} and user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: select count(1) from toy_community_like where post_id = #{postId} and user_id = #{userId}
